case_text:
Vignette:
A 28-year-old woman presents with a cluster of small blisters on her lower lip that appeared today. She reports a tingling and burning sensation in the area that started yesterday. She has experienced similar episodes approximately twice a year for the past 5 years. She notes she has been under increased stress at work. She denies fever, sore throat, or oral ulcers. On examination, there is a cluster of small fluid-filled vesicles on an erythematous base on the left lower lip at the vermilion border. There is no facial nerve involvement, no lymphadenopathy, and no intraoral lesions.
